title: Bolivia: Rural Community Flood and Drought Resilience in the Bolivian Highlands
temporal_coverage: EVAs project implementation in 2011–2017; terminal evaluation in 2017; post-completion assessment in 2023; regional climate modeling through 2070.
methodology: Five-page case study synthesizes project-close and 2023 post-completion evaluations.
limitations: Regional evaluation synthesis, not a representative climate-impact survey.

title: Impacts of Wildfires on Economic, Social, Cultural and Environmental Rights and Biodiversity: Report of REDESCA's Working Visit to Bolivia
organization: Inter-American Commission on Human Rights, Office of the Special Rapporteur on Economic, Social, Cultural and Environmental Rights (REDESCA)
temporal_coverage: Examines the 2024 wildfire emergency; REDESCA mission conducted 9–11 December 2024; report approved 30 May 2025.
methodology: Mission to La Paz, Santa Cruz and San Ignacio; reviewed official information and community testimony.
limitations: Field mission, not a representative survey or fire-attribution study.

title: De la emergencia a la gestión de riesgos por sequía: el caso de las ciudades de La Paz y El Alto en Bolivia y sus lecciones aprendidas
organization: Inter-American Development Bank, Water and Sanitation Division
temporal_coverage: Reviews the 2016–2017 and 2022–2023 drought episodes, the EPSAS drought-management protocol introduced in 2018, and system operation through 2024.
methodology: Full 114-page Spanish note using EPSAS operational data.
limitations: Provider case study; household impacts unmeasured.

title: Adaptation Planning in Bolivia
organization: United Nations Development Programme Accelerator Lab Bolivia
temporal_coverage: Reports on a UNDP Accelerator Lab adaptation-planning prototype; page does not state implementation dates.
methodology: Read the full case study describing deliberative workshops, a community survey and co-designed planning map.
limitations: The case is explicitly a prototype/pilot, not an evaluation of institutionalized or scaled adaptation outcomes.

title: Bolivia, Country Strategic Outcome 2: Decentralized Evaluation (2023–2025)
organization: World Food Programme, Office of Evaluation
temporal_coverage: Evaluation covers WFP Bolivia Country Strategic Plan outcome implementation from January 2023 through December 2024.
methodology: Read the complete official evaluation synopsis page; its linked evaluation PDF required JavaScript bot verification and was not read.
limitations: Claims are limited to the posted synopsis; detailed evaluation methods and findings were not verified in the PDF.
